_README: Claude Startup Kit — user config. Edit the user copy at ~/.claude/scripts/startup-kit-config.json. The installer copies this default file ONLY when no user config exists; subsequent installs preserve your customizations.

window._adaptive_help: When true, cols/lines/fontSize are computed from the screen resolution. Set false to lock to the values below.

selfUpdate._repoPath_help: Absolute path to the cloned claude-startup-kit repo. Auto-detected on install if you ran install.ps1 from inside the repo.
selfUpdate._autoApply_help: When true, the brief will git-pull and re-install automatically once per 24h if origin/main is ahead of local. Off by default — flip to true after testing.
selfUpdate._minHoursBetweenChecks_help: Throttle for the auto-check. 24 = once per day.
